intent: Reduce time to first spoken answer and play brief localized, turn-bound acknowledgments while the answer or a real lookup is being prepared.
behavior: Give a speakable reply priority. Offer at most one foreground acknowledgment per eligible new turn, after 850 ms of ordinary preparation or 180 ms of confirmed lookup activity. Never send an extra model request.

Preserve an audible acknowledgment through its phrase boundary. Retire an unheard one as soon as the answer can speak. Keep synthetic status outside the stored answer and measure its first audio separately.

Overlap Android output setup with model loading, prefetch installed bundle headers during native microphone startup, and release stable initial words on a bounded timer in both foreground and service playback. Reuse a local model already loading for an unheard cue when the same voice starts the answer.

covered: Cues in eight languages, including French
Existing reply priority, duplicate suppression, interruption and stale callbacks
Overlap between audio setup and graph creation
One cold graph load when an unheard cue yields to the answer, with explicit Stop still honored
Background delivery of stable words during a provider pause

integrityReview.intent: Verify audio ownership through the acknowledgment, final answer, chat switching and system controls, and reconcile the speech-related validation failures.
regressions: A detached French acknowledgment dropped the terminal answer if it arrived while the acknowledgment played or after it finished during a provider pause. Both timing orders and cue-only completion now have regressions.
Before the repair, everyday French spacing before punctuation made the answer repeat an audible acknowledgment.
Playback and capture must arbitrate between runtimes. Reopening a chat must retain control of the playing message without retargeting an older notification.

verification.composeTimer: The real Compose effect cancels a pending acknowledgment when the answer arrives, replaces it on a real lookup, and emits only the due lookup cue.
verification.sqlite: The production playback query on the exported Room v54 schema rejects wrong room, message, run, and ownership fence.
verification.realModelCheck: The hosted Kokoro CPU and requested GPU smoke streams use ff_siwis and fr for a French corpus with accents and an elision. The receipt records waveform, caption byte spans, and the CPU comparison for a completed GPU run.
verification.deviceMeasurements: Physical Android listening, latency, sustained background audio and accelerator performance remain unmeasured.
verification.mediaControls: Notification and media-session taps target the same reply. A delayed pause or Stop from another reply cannot cancel the new owner.

acceleratorCompatibilityReview.intent: Verify the actual Android speech SDK and Qualcomm provider interfaces, and improve startup, output validity and compiled-cache compatibility for foreground and service playback.

upstream.verified: The AAR TTS nativeCreate receives the delegate enum, rate, bucket, default voice and locale, model path and cache path. The generic NPU and GPU options from BaseOptions are not arguments of this native method.
The Android publisher validates these two packages together. The app links its native Kokoro ARM64 bridge against static ONNX Runtime 1.31.0.

upstream.localLanguageModel: LiteRT-LM 0.20.0 reviewed. The app's 0.18.0 dispatch build is separate from MediaPipe Tasks Audio synthesis.

upstream.driverDiscovery: Android 12 or later requires explicit optional vendor library declarations.

routing: Standard Kokoro can satisfy live startup and prefetch when either optimized pack is unavailable. A failed specialized lease or late driver load can recover with the same voice and rate. An exact benchmark never substitutes a different delegate.

Reject nonfinite output, any accelerator magnitude above full scale or four consecutive full-scale samples across SDK packets. A failed first packet can be retried locally. After audio or captions were delivered, the damaged packet is withheld and no published text is replayed.
GPU and NPU caches and successful-voice records share a firmware, ABI, native dependency and app-install identity. The existing CPU cache key and previous CPU voice records remain usable.

verification.beforeAndAfter: Missing optimized packs, a lazy NPU loader error, corrupt first PCM and saturation across packets each failed with the previous factory/engine and passed with the candidate.
verification.packaging: The 1.2.3 ARM64 and x86_64 native binaries reference libOpenCL.so, libOpenCL-pixel.so and libOpenCL-car.so. Gradle's ARM64, x86_64 and universal packaged manifests expose all three and FastRPC as optional.
verification.nativeContracts: QNN provenance and C++/JNI context, cancellation, retirement and waveform validation controls passed on the host.
verification.handsetRunner: The manual minified native smoke workflow stages an ARM64 APK pair. The runner and verifier accept an explicit GPU or NPU request, the French waveform and startup timing, Android AudioTrack presentation, pronunciation, captions and cancellation. Synthetic runs exercise both routes and reject mismatched or clipped evidence.
verification.physicalQualification: No physical Android device was attached. ROG Phone 9 Pro kernel placement, cold/warm latency, listening quality and sustained performance are unmeasured for this candidate.

preexistingMinifiedFailure.cause: The separate test APK invoked the optimized-away Kotlin configurePronunciation default bridge. Both instrumentation callers now pass English explicitly. Smoke-only R8 roots preserve the signal and NPU setup APIs that the separate test APK directly calls.
preexistingMinifiedFailure.integration: Retained the concurrent fix in 4eb088e16 and verified both compiled instrumentation callers invoke the explicit two-argument method. The new accelerated handset probe adds narrow smoke-only method retention.

fullVoiceBenchmark.intent: Replace the manual configuration matrix with one full on-device voice benchmark and one export that preserves detailed measurements, skips and interrupted work.
fullVoiceBenchmark.entry: Voice settings → Run full voice benchmark → Export full voice benchmark
fullVoiceBenchmark.execution: Activity-owned coordinator holds the process-wide microphone/playback lease. Native, streaming and playback runners execute sequentially, await retirement, and preserve strict model/delegate identities. Missing packs are reported before scheduling. Cooldown is bounded to five minutes; unresolved thermal pressure or native cleanup stops remaining stages.
coverage: Four microphone batch sizes and audio route/effect capabilities
Two fixed English recognition recordings with three Moonshine endpointing styles; edit distance, first partial and final timings

All catalog languages and voices, dictionary source alignment, acoustic signal, first PCM and timed word cues; measure Android on-device loopback accuracy only when the engine reads the supplied audio
Android offline system voices rendered to validated WAV, reported language availability, and a previously selected CUDA Gateway
Native INT8 and FP32, standard/optimized Kokoro, Phonon and Pocket, supported CPU/GPU/NPU requests, device thread counts, QNN policies, LiteRT sequence buckets and text-input modes
Short/medium/long workloads, 20 warm repeats, caption offset, cancellation/recovery, playback gaps, bounded battery and thermal observations, and 1/5/10-minute sustained targets
Production automatic thread calibration, localized thinking/search cue planning and process-scoped live voice timings

fixtures.source: Local synthesis with FFmpeg Flite voices slt and rms. G.711 mu-law mono at 16 kHz. The English references appear in VoiceBenchRecognition.kt.

fullVoiceBenchmark.evidence: The aggregate streams the original public benchmark exports, fixture metrics and separate live-session performance snapshot. Audio, transcripts, device addresses, connection credentials and local device keys are excluded. Driver kernel utilization, acoustic ear latency and subjective naturalness require independent observation.
fullVoiceBenchmark.limits: The mobile suite covers connected audio routes and installed engines. Windows CUDA requires an explicitly selected Gateway. Unsupported hardware, missing language models, process death, user cancellation and thermal stops are preserved in the report.

preparedOpenings.intent: Preload localized speech at microphone start, suppress short answers and let generated speech interrupt an acknowledgement immediately. Improve pronunciation and sentence flow.
